traits.name: whimsy
traits.reason: Gentle wordplay and absurd reversals like 'the door I haven't built yet' and 'Gold is heavy. Bring a friend', but only one item renaming (fudge) and little fres

traits.name: secrecy
traits.reason: He openly gives coordinates and invites people to find the factory; no riddles, hidden faction names, or concealed tricks.

traits.name: tests honesty
traits.reason: No goals, confirmations, or promise-weighted prizes appear; the only gesture is candidly admitting nothing has been built.

traits.name: mercurial
traits.reason: Mostly one gentle, wry register repeated; a faint deadpan landing appears but no manic phase or sharp pivots.

traits.name: generosity
traits.reason: Friendly invitations to bring a friend or hand cart, but no escrowed rewards, tours, or gifts.
